title: Cadence vs GoodTime for small recruiting teams
description: GoodTime is a strong enterprise scheduling platform. Cadence covers the same core job for small teams — GDPR tooling built in, free during early access.

faq.q: Who is GoodTime best suited for?
faq.a: Enterprise and high-volume talent teams with dedicated coordinators: deep ATS coverage across many systems, interview intelligence, campus and high-volume hiring workflows, and analytics at organizational scale.

faq.q: When does Cadence make more sense than an enterprise platform?
faq.a: When the team scheduling interviews is one to a handful of recruiters without a coordination function, needs the follow-through automated rather than staffed, hires under GDPR, and wants transparent pricing — free during early access — instead of a sales-led contract.
